items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 4:01 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Finance and Corporate Services Committee report - March 9, 2026
Savic Homes, 1438 Highland Road W - Section 20 Development Charges Complaint - Jurisdiction Hearing, FIN-2026-097
notes: It was noted during the Finance and Corporate Services meeting that that matter had been appealed to the Ontario Land Tribunal and was no longer within the City's jurisdiction. This matter was withdrawn from the agenda.

items.title: Savic Homes, 15 Dellroy Avenue - Section 20 Development Charges Complaint - Jurisdiction Hearing, FIN-2026-098
Mayoral Business and Updates - Mayor B. Vrbanovic
To confirm all actions and proceedings of the Council for March 9, 2026.
Adjournment
notes: On motion the meeting adjourned at 4:04 p.m.
